# ThinkingOrbsKit

Unmodified copy of `packages/thinking-orbs/ports/ios/ThinkingOrbsKit/Sources/ThinkingOrbsKit`
from https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev at commit
`b0e5a8f1e659ac549e6035e42a750e73678ed67a`, MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`).

Vendored rather than added as a package dependency because the upstream repository has no
usable version tags and is ~115 MB; to update, copy the same folder from a newer commit and
record its hash here.
